e6: anti-stud ↔ pin is not a compatible pair
notes: The booklet pictures are small and ambiguous, so many exact ports and stud positions are approximate; the overall piece-to-piece connectivity is the intended one.
Ids are in approximate build order. b38 (a Technic pin holding the first round brick on the engine pod) is numbered last to keep the 38-piece inventory exact.

Pod (steps 1-4): two Technic bricks side by side joined by a pin, with a round 1x1 brick on a pin at each outer hole. The black bits in step 4 were read as parts of the later wing assemblies, not as extra parts on the pod.

Cockpit: pin in a Technic brick, black jumper plate on top, trans-brown curved brick with the radar dish on the front, then a dark gray curved brick on top at step 5. The curved bricks have no studs, so those joins use null ports.

The two wings (steps 6 and 7) are mirror-image sub-assemblies. Each has two 3x3 wedge plates, a hinge pair (44567a with 44570), a yellow 4x2 wedge, a 1x6 tile, a clip plate holding an antenna, and two yellow flags on side-handle plates. The white round plate is only on the left wing. The pod and cockpit sit on top of both wings.
Black jumper plate 3794a was placed in the cockpit; it could also have been in the right wing near the flags.
Not repeats: the wings differ in handedness and in the white round plate.
